model.note: BM25 and TF-IDF cosine are lexical; no embedding or language model was run.

variants.hybrid: weighted RRF via ragfuse, bm25 weight 0.5
variants.parent: BM25 over lines and sentences, sections by best child
variants.graph: BM25 seeds plus their explicit reference targets, one hop

test_runs: First test run: the six variants as declared, before any test number was seen.

Later runs, all after review: diagnostics (graph reach, miss kinds), the shared rageval.stats bootstrap, refactors and wording. Every variant keeps the same passages for every query as in the first run.

uncertainty.unit: case (paraphrases of one case are averaged first)
uncertainty.sign_flip: exact, two-sided, over every sign pattern of the case differences
uncertainty.bootstrap: rageval.stats paired bootstrap, 10000 case resamples, seed 70
